界面挂载完成后执行一次，无参数；不代表页面资源或请求加载完成。: Called once, without arguments, after the UI mounts. It does not mean page resources or requests have finished loading.
数量上限建议传正整数；小数向下取整，至少保留 1 条。初始化时 0、负数或非有限: Use positive integer limits. Fractions are rounded down, with a minimum of one. At initialization, zero, negative or non-finite values use defaults. Hiding the panel, entry button or export UI does not stop capture; call destroy() when done.
onReady 可能同步执行，请通过 GravScope.current 访问实: onReady may run synchronously; access the instance via GravScope.current. Runtime setOption() supports theme, maxLogNumber, maxNetworkNumber, entryButton, preserveLogs, capture, networkIgnore and redactKeys. Other options require a new instance.
以下示例假设已创建 const panel = new GravScope()。: Examples assume const panel = new GravScope(). All methods are synchronous; void means no return value and no chaining.
打开面板并清除未读数量，不清空日志。: Open the panel and reset the unread count without clearing logs.
参数：id: string，已添加的面板 ID。: Parameters: id: string, the ID of an installed panel.
切换并打开面板。内置 ID 为 log、network、errors、eleme: Select a tab and open the panel. Built-in IDs: log, network, errors, element, storage, system, timeline, performance, streams. Custom panels use plugin.id. An unknown ID keeps the current tab but still opens the panel.
参数：key: 'theme'，value: 'light' / 'dark': Parameters: key: 'theme', value: 'light' / 'dark' / 'auto'; key: 'maxLogNumber' / 'maxNetworkNumber', value: number; or key: 'entryButton', value: boolean.
即时修改主题、容量或悬浮入口。运行时容量向下取整并至少为 1；非有限值忽略（不同: Update the theme, retention limit or floating entry immediately. Runtime limits are rounded down with a minimum of one; non-finite values are ignored (unlike initialization defaults). Invalid themes are ignored. Since 0.2.0, also accepts preserveLogs (boolean), capture (Partial<CaptureOptions>), networkIgnore / redactKeys (string[]). Lower limits immediately evict old records. Runtime entryButton updates are available since 0.1.2: false hides it immediately; true shows it only when the panel is collapsed. This does not collapse the panel or stop capture. Non-boolean entryButton values are ignored.

添加标签并同步触发 init、render。ID 必须唯一，与现有内置或自定义插: Add a tab and synchronously emit init and render. The ID must be unique; a collision with a built-in or custom plugin throws. Does not automatically select the new tab.
参数：id: string，要移除的插件 ID。: Parameters: id: string, the plugin ID to remove.
触发 remove 并移除标签；ID 不存在则不操作。移除当前标签会切换到第一个: Emit remove and remove the tab; an unknown ID is a no-op. Removing the current tab selects the first remaining tab. If a remove callback throws, the tab is still removed and the error propagates. Removing Network does not stop network capture.
移除界面，触发插件 remove，释放实例持有的采集钩子与监听，清空 GravS: Remove the UI, emit remove, release capture hooks and listeners owned by the instance, and clear GravScope.current. Safe to repeat. Plugin cleanup errors do not prevent destruction. Create a new instance to resume debugging.

字段内容经过脱敏和截断，不应当作原始对象；请在 destroy() 前取得报告。: Fields are redacted and truncated, not original objects. Obtain the report before calling destroy().

无。返回工具数组的浅拷贝；按钮对象本身仍共享，不应修改它们。: None. Returns a shallow copy of the tools array. Button objects are shared and should not be modified.

请在 addPlugin() 前注册回调和工具。id、name 为只读字符串，空: Register callbacks and tools before addPlugin(). id and name are read-only strings; an empty id throws. on and addTool return the plugin for chaining. getTools returns a shallow copy. There is no off() method; clean up your listeners and timers in remove. The toolbar reads tools when the tab activates; appending a tool does not immediately redraw it.
日志工具栏保留清空、暂停滚动、最新，其余操作放入「更多」。大量日志每页显示 20: The log toolbar keeps Clear, Pause scrolling and Latest visible; other actions are under More. Logs are paged at 200 records plus up to 100 group-context records. Search and copy cover all retained records.
网络面板新增方法与精确状态码 / 状态段筛选，以及 cURL 复制。日志可暂停滚: Network supports method and exact status / status-family filters, plus Copy as cURL. Pause log scrolling and resume following after checking the new-entry count. Errors aggregates JavaScript, Promise, resource and console errors.
日志工具栏的「采集设置」可独立启停 Console、Network、Errors: Capture settings under More independently toggle Console, Network and Errors; setOption('capture', { network: false }) is also supported. Disabling capture neither removes records nor cancels page requests. Re-enabling captures new activity. Available since 0.2.0; report replay also accepts 0.1.2 JSON reports.
新增 timeline 时间线、performance 性能、streams 实: Timeline, Performance and Streams panels are available. Inspect logs and requests within 30 seconds before and after an error. Network uses 100 records per page. Storage supports search, JSON formatting/validation, explicit saving and deletion confirmation. Performance summarizes slow requests, known sizes and browser-supported long tasks.
capture 新增 navigation、performance、realti: capture includes navigation, performance and realtime toggles. Realtime capture observes new WebSocket / EventSource connections, default messages and named SSE events registered by the application. Text is limited to 2,000 characters per entry; activity shares a 1,000-entry retention limit. Business connections are not closed; fetch-based SSE bodies are not buffered.
networkIgnore 按区分大小写的 URL 子串排除后续请求与新连接；r: networkIgnore excludes later requests and new connections by case-sensitive URL substring. redactKeys matches whole field names case-insensitively in reports and history without changing raw records. Both arrays replace previous rules: 1–100 characters per entry, up to 100 entries.
onExport(file)：由宿主保存或分享: onExport(file): let the host save or share
仅初始化配置，类型为 (file: ExportFile) => void |: Initialization only: (file: ExportFile) => void | Promise<void>. Triggered by HTML/JSON export buttons, not by Copy, Select all or getReport(). Available since 0.2.0.
本次接管任务编号，可交给原生关联回执: Export task ID for correlating native acknowledgments
脱敏后的文本，不是 Blob、文件路径或 Base64: Redacted text, not a Blob, file path or Base64
不配置时仍通过 Blob 发起浏览器下载。配置后完全接管导出，不再自动下载；实例: Without a callback, export initiates a browser Blob download. With a callback, it takes full control and no automatic download occurs. Export buttons are disabled while the instance's task is pending, including after reopening the dialog; the task ID and filename remain visible. After 30 seconds, a waiting notice appears. Confirming Cancel waiting only stops the component from waiting; the native operation may continue and retrying may duplicate it. Stale acknowledgments do not overwrite new tasks. Throws or rejections show failure and allow retry/copy, without fallback downloading. Closing the dialog does not cancel native work; callback completion is not treated as proof that a file was saved.
原生端负责 UTF-8 编码、文件保存/分享和回执。仅发送 postMessag: The native host handles UTF-8 encoding, file saving/sharing and acknowledgment. Sending postMessage alone does not prove success. Bridge size limits, chunking, uploads and cancellation belong to the application. File extensions aid recognition but do not provide WebView download support. exportEnabled: false hides export UI only; getReport() remains available.
无参数，清空日志、请求、活动、自定义系统信息与历史存档内容，并关闭旧报告预览。: takes no arguments. Clears logs, requests, activity, custom system information and saved history, and closes the old report preview. Keeps capture/history preferences, business storage and connections; does not cancel exports already handed to native code. The More menu asks for confirmation; the API runs directly. No-op after destruction.
JSON 预览显示 UTF-8 字节大小，JSON/HTML 导出上限均为 5: JSON preview shows UTF-8 byte size. JSON and HTML exports are limited to 5 MiB, with HTML checked again after escaping. getReport() also enforces report size and a 10,000-entry limit each for filtered logs/requests. Exceeding a limit throws ReportLimitError without truncation or calling onExport. Narrow the time range or exclude bodies and retry.
采集接口受保护时按通道回滚、停用并提示，不阻断其他面板；采集设置支持重试。日志对: Protected capture APIs are rolled back and disabled per channel with a visible notice; other panels keep working. Capture settings can retry. Logged objects are retained by reference; values may change before expansion or export.
无参数，返回六通道状态副本，每项含 enabled、state、detail。: takes no arguments. Returns a copy of six channel states, each with enabled, state and detail. state is enabled / disabled / unavailable / failed, distinguishing active capture, disabled capture, unsupported environments and initialization failure. Changing the copy does not change configuration. Returns disabled states after destruction.
面板显示采集状态，采集设置提供详细覆盖范围；实时面板明确仅观察新建连接。官网实验: The panel shows capture status; capture settings explain coverage. Streams explicitly observes only new connections. This playground uses 0.2.2.
日志筛选栏开启「保留日志」，或初始化传 preserveLogs: true。支: Enable Preserve logs in the log filter bar, or initialize with preserveLogs: true. Toggle at runtime with setOption('preserveLogs', true / false). Available since 0.2.0.
使用当前标签页的同源 sessionStorage，默认关闭，开启后记住会话偏好: Uses same-origin sessionStorage in the current tab. Off by default; enabling remembers the session preference. Stores up to 200 redacted static log records within about 256 KiB of JSON. Restored records are marked as historical and separated from the new session. Clearing deletes saved content; disabling deletes saved history but keeps currently displayed records.
不保存网络请求和命令源码；存储不可用或页面被强杀时可能无法完整恢复。: Network requests and command source are not saved. Recovery may be incomplete if storage is unavailable or the page is forcibly terminated.
性能与系统面板统一展示 DNS、连接、TLS、请求/导航首字节、文档下载、DOM: Performance and System show DNS, connection, TLS, request/navigation TTFB, download, DOM readiness, Load, FP/FCP and document sizes. Search, copy and JSON/HTML export are supported; replay includes the performance field.
value 为数值或 null；unit 为 ms / bytes；state: value is a number or null; unit is ms / bytes; state is available / pending / unavailable. Zero is valid; missing or unsupported values are not fabricated. Load does not mean application readiness. These are browser snapshots for the current document, not standard LCP/CLS/INP scores, SPA route timings or BFCache restoration timings. Disabling long-task capture does not disable these snapshots; clearing diagnostics does not clear browser timings.
iframe 历史按固定框架位置隔离，并在报告中标明来源。动态增删或重排仍需谨慎: iframe history is isolated by fixed frame position, with source metadata in reports. Use caution with dynamic insertion, removal or reordering. Cross-frame log aggregation is not included.
小工具，也有明确边界。: A small tool with clear boundaries.
支持浅色、深色、跟随系统，以及中英文。日志默认启用，可配置其他面板；隐藏网络面板: Supports light, dark and system themes, plus Chinese and English. Logs is always enabled; other panels are configurable. Hiding Network does not stop network capture. Add your own tools through GravScopePlugin.
导出的报告包含什么？: What is in an exported report?
已保留的日志、请求与设备信息。请求体和响应体默认排除；不含本地存储和命令源码。常: Retained logs, requests and device information. Request and response bodies are excluded by default; local storage and command source are excluded. Common credentials and URL parameter values are masked, but not all sensitive business information can be recognized. Object values reflect export time; reports are not session recordings.
fetch 响应预览最多读取约 100 KB，SSE 响应体不缓存。跨域响应的可: fetch response previews read up to about 100 KB; SSE bodies are not buffered. Cross-origin response visibility follows browser restrictions. Device compatibility, long-running performance and mobile downloads remain under validation; try it on your target devices first.
命令行会在当前页面执行 JavaScript，请勿面向终端用户默认启用。Grav: The command line runs JavaScript in the current page. Do not enable it for end users by default. GravScope does not automatically upload diagnostic reports. Demo interactions access this site's static resources and may write sample local storage.
